lines.speaker: At the axle
lines.text: One knock from Kael. He holds his palm clear of the timber. A hard tap answers from the far bank. The cord slips loose. For a moment he can hear the water through the gap.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: A way through. When the one with the cord steps out, I'll put my blade away and give that answer close enough to see its face.
